findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:16 says .githooks/pre-push runs package build plus recursive tsc for the self-host repo, and line 38 frames pre-push as a possible narrower build+tsc safety net. The current hook only enters that build/tsc path when packages/main/package.json name equals @koala-agent/core (.githooks/pre-push:147-150), but the current package is @lattice-agent/core (packages/main/package.json:2), so for this repo the hook exits before build+tsc. The document is still right that pre-push does not run root npm test, but it overstates the present release/push assurance surface and should describe the current no-root-npm-test boundary without claiming build+tsc coverage unless the self-host detection is fixed or deliberately scoped.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bc66cec: document now states current pre-push does not run root npm test and its build+tsc branch is still keyed to @koala-agent/core while this repo is @lattice-agent/core, so it must not be claimed as current self-host build+tsc assurance.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:147 introduces DONE-blocking missing/failing/stale DONE-required evidence, and docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:168-175 plans the runner/artifact/DONE oracle row, but the plan never requires updating packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts, process-fact-levels, or scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs. AGENTS.md:64 and docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:194-195 require every new gate evidence/artifact/process fact to be registered and contract-verified; the comparable 3x2 plan does this explicitly at docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md:706-708. As written, the future implementation plan can change DONE gate evidence without the required registry/contract backstop.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bc66cec: plan now explicitly requires future implementation updates to packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts, packages/main/src/core/process-fact-levels.ts, and scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs for the new DONE-required gate evidence/artifact.

findings.desc: The execution plan does not make a fresh build a required part of the DONE-required proof. The recommended policy examples run only `npm test` (docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:40 and :58), and the self-host milestone says to require root `npm test` or an equivalent full-suite command (docs/requirements/decisions/done-full-test-gate-execution-plan.md:215). Root `npm test` mostly executes built `packages/main/dist/tasks/...` scripts (package.json:15 and :21), and packages/main builds those outputs from TypeScript (packages/main/package.json:22). `currentMaterialHash` is computed from tracked git tree objects (packages/main/src/core/evidence-freshness.ts:217), while `git ls-files packages/main/dist` returns no tracked files. A future implementation can therefore produce hash-fresh PASS evidence by running tests against stale generated dist. The plan should require either a DONE-required build step before `npm test`, a root `pretest`/test script that builds, or an explicit equivalent command whose receipt proves the build output came from the same material hash.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bc66cec: plan now requires npm --prefix packages/main run build before root npm test, or an equivalent root pretest/build receipt proving packages/main/dist matches the same headHash/materialHash; negative tests include stale/missing build receipt blocking DONE.
